newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks open broadly higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks open broadly higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened higher on Tuesday, as expected, boosted by strength in the bond market.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 10 to 5,704, while the NASDAQ Index was up five to 1,144 and the S&P Index up one to 665.
New York Stock Exchange advances led declines by 516/380 and NASDAQ advances topped declines 991/610.
The 30-year U.S. Treasury bond was up 13/32 to yield 6.97 percent.
